reviews.title: Fraudulent charges
reviews.text: Be careful before installing this app. I got charged repeatedly through JazzCash for a subscription I never knowingly activated. Worse — when I open the app and tap "Cancel Subscription," I get a confirmation message, but the subscription quietly reactivates itself and I get charged again shortly after. This has happened more than once. Either this is a serious bug in their billing system or it's intentional dark-pattern billing designed to make cancellation look successful while charges continue. I've had to file complaints with JazzCash and PTA over this. Do not save your payment details in this app. If you face this issue immediately transfer your all payments from jazzcash to other accounts.
